senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; קָדַשׁ)sanctity, sacred affair, sacred ground, dedicated object.
units: <cite ref="Yoma 12b">Yoma 12ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>מעלין בק׳</he>, v. <cite ref="P00772"><he>עָלָה</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 16:1">Sabb. XVI, 1</cite> <he>כל כתבי הק׳ וכ׳</he> all sacred scriptures must be saved from fire (on the Sabbath). Tosef. ib. XIII (XIV), 1 <he>אין קורין בכתבי הק׳</he> we must not read from the Hagiographa (on the Sabbath); Y. ib. XVI, 15ᶜ top <he>אין קורין בכתבי הק׳ אלא וכ׳</he> we must not read from the Hagiographa except from the afternoon service onward.
<cite ref="Beitzah 5a:2">Bets. 5ᵃ</cite> <he>נוהגין אותו היום ק׳ וכ׳</he> we observe the rest of the day as a holy day and the next day likewise.

<cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 1:7">Ib. I, 7</cite> <he>בין ק׳ לק׳</he>, v. <cite ref="B00150"><he>בָּדַל</he></cite>; <cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 1:7">ib.</cite> <he>בין ק׳ חמוד לק׳ הקל</he> between the stricter and the lighter sanctities; a. v. fr.—<he>שם ק׳</he> or <he>ק׳</he> (sub. <cite ref="U01406"><he>שם</he></cite>) sacred name, name of the Lord.
<cite ref="Tractate Soferim 4:6">Treat. Sof’rim IV, 6</cite>, sq.; a. fr.—<he>רוח הק׳</he>, v. <cite ref="T00615"><he>רוּחַ</he></cite>.—Esp.

<cite ref="Mishnah Zevachim 9:2">Zeb. IX, 2</cite> <he>כל שפסולו בק׳ הק׳ מקבלו</he> whatever has become unfit within the sanctuary, the sanctuary accepts (it cannot be removed from the altar, if it was put on); <he>לא היה פסולו בק׳ וכ׳</he> if its unfitness did not arise within the sacred precincts, the sanctuary does not accept it; a. fr.—
senses.label: a

senses.gloss: הק׳ the Holy, contrad. to עֲזָרָה, a. to ק׳ הקדשים, v. infra.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 3:3">Yoma III, 3</cite>; <cite ref="Mishnah Yoma 3:6">6</cite> <he>בק׳</he> within the precincts of the Holy.
Midd. IV, 5; a. fr.—Pl. קֳדָשִׁים.—קודש הק׳, also קָדְשֵׁי ק׳ most holy, esp. the Holy of Holies, the westernmost compartment of the Temple. Midd. l. c.
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:1:11">Cant. R. to I, 1</cite> <he>כל הכתובים קדש וזה ק׳ הק׳</he> all Biblical scriptures are holy, but this (Song of Songs) is most holy.
Y. Meg. III, 74ᵃ, a. e. נחום איש קדש הק׳ Nahum, the man of extreme holiness; a. e.—Esp. קֳדָשִׁים consecrated objects, sacrifices.
<cite ref="Mishnah Zevachim 5:4">Zeb. V, 4</cite> <he>העולה קדשי ק׳</he> the burnt-offering belongs to the highest class of sacrifices.
<cite ref="Mishnah Zevachim 5:6">Ib. 6</cite>, sq. <he>ק׳ קלים</he> sacrifices of a minor grade.

Ib. X, 2 מפני שהוא קדשי ק׳ because it belongs to the highest grade; a. fr.—קדשי מזבח things dedicated for the altar, sacrifices; קדשי בדק הבית objects dedicated (for their value) to be used for the needs of the Temple building.
Tem. VII, 1, sq.; a. fr.—ק׳ (סדר) Kodashim, the fifth of the six orders of the Mishnah, Tosefta, a. Talmud Babli.
